component.name: ChatGPT Desktop Wrapper
component.summary: Run the official ChatGPT Linux application in a Flatpak sandbox

description.p: An unofficial Flatpak wrapper for the proprietary ChatGPT desktop application published by OpenAI. The upstream RPM is downloaded directly from OpenAI during installation and is not redistributed by this project.
This Flathub-oriented build uses a restricted sandbox. Some ChatGPT and Codex features that require direct access to host projects or commands may not be available.

screenshot.caption: Signing in to ChatGPT from the desktop application
